status_definitions.source_recovered_complete: Entire original unit recovered and represented in current-target source. No unit meets this threshold.
status_definitions.source_recovered_partial: Documented current-target source portions exist for this subsystem; notes identify the bounded portion and missing owners.
status_definitions.historical_unrevalidated: Related source exists only with historical target provenance and is not counted as current recovered source.
status_definitions.missing: No reviewed current-target implementation for this unit identified in this bounded source/report audit; data, interfaces and source-path names alone do not count.
